purpose: 27B CUDA prefill microbatch, file-cache and disk-streaming calibration
scope: Native prefill and disk-backed state export; not a 27B CUDA-to-Metal TTFT benchmark

method.warmup: One full canonical prompt per candidate; excluded from measured medians
method.prompt_cache: Empty before every trial; native cache_n=0 checked
method.prefix: Evaluate N-1 canonical tokens, discard one sampled token, save exactly N-1
method.cpu_weight_placement: Native mmap and operation offload; per-run overrides recorded
method.order: Ascending microbatch candidates; repetitions are not randomized or alternating

notes: Completed measured trials alone contribute to comparison medians; warmup is separate.
GPU utilization is sampled device activity. Low activity alone does not prove a disk bottleneck.
Physical read counters, major faults, and memory/IO pressure provide additional evidence.
Read rate is derived from consecutive same-phase counter samples, not from GPU utilization.
Missing, dropped, and truncated telemetry remains explicit. Sampling can miss short peaks.
CUDA prefill excludes the final canonical token; native counts and exercised chunks are shown.
Times are native inference/export timers unless a column explicitly says client or wall.
GPU activity phase summaries cover the full trial, including export and client overhead; they are not prefill-only kernel measurements.
A completed inference trial and a clean process exit are distinct; both statuses are retained.
Earlier 8192 runs wrote all results but exited 139 during NVML cleanup; fixed in 5c5bb4c and verified by later clean runs.
The 3072 candidate failed on TCP TIME_WAIT handling before inference, not OOM; fixed in 94ea80f.
The 65535 run and the extra 8192 RAM trial were deliberately cancelled when the user redirected the experiment.
Cgroup file bytes include charged file cache, not only weights or every globally resident shared GGUF page.
The model checksum and loader touch the file before trials; these are not cold-disk measurements.
Container no-swap does not prohibit host swapping of unrelated memory; host swap counters are retained where sampled.
No watchdog or sampled minimum guarantees that every future workload will avoid OOM.
